name: Stacy's Simply Naked Pita Chips
whyItWorks: Real sliced pita bread twice-baked to a golden crunch with sunflower oil and sea salt. Seedless, non-spicy, and low in fiber (1g).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew well before swallowing to ensure edges are fully softened. Pairs well with smooth garlic-free hummus.
